verdict.rationale: Docs say that once installed on GitHub, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests and comments on bugs and improvements. Developers can reply to its review-comment threads, and cubic can auto-resolve those threads when issues are fixed, which implies native in-PR review comments. Onboarding is pitched as "in minutes". Missing for 10: any GitLab support (evidence is GitHub-only), explicit documentation that findings are posted as line-level inline comments, stated turnaround time for standard reviews, and independent hands-on corroboration of the PR integration.
